text:
maria-sales: Quick heads-up — NovaHealth POC asked for: 1) Net60 on PO, 2) e-sign to go through their SSO with HSM-backed signatures, and 3) they redlined the DPA asking us to list subprocessors. @kevin-legal @tara-ops can you advise?

kevin-legal: We can sometimes accept Net60 for strategic deals but need sign-off from finance. For the DPA, ask them to identify which subprocessors matter; we can provide our standard list and limited carveouts. For the HSM requirement, need more detail on attestation and whether they require our key in their HSM or just proof of HSM usage.

maria-sales: Good call. I asked them to confirm whether they want our keys transferred or merely an HSM-signed artifact. They said: "must be HSM-backed sig and integrate with our Okta SSO flow for signing". No details on key custody.

tara-ops: If they want our private key moved into their HSM = non-starter. If they want signatures produced by our service but verifiable via an HSM attest, that's doable with engineering time. Need to know timeline.

sanjay-se: From an implementation POV, we can offer two options:
1) Standard DocuSign/esign flow + audit log + KMS-backed keys (we hold keys, provide signature verification).
2) Customer-managed KMS/HSM integration (Private deployment) — requires Dedicated/Private contract + onboarding, ~4-6 weeks.

maria-sales: They prefer option 1 if possible, but want the signature anchored to an HSM attestation. They also want a pricing exception because they'd pay monthly after Net60. Any recommended language to get finance comfortable?

tom-accounting: Net60 is possible for pilots but we need a smaller prepay or a credit holdback to reduce risk. Suggest 25% upfront or a PO holdback clause in order form. Can we do a 25% prepay + Net60 balance?

kevin-legal: Draft clause idea for order form: 
```
Payment Terms: Customer will issue a PO payable Net60. Redwood Inference reserves the right to require a 25% prepayment for initial POC deployment. If prepayment is not provided within 5 business days of PO, Redwood may pause provisioning until payment or alternative security (e.g., credit card or signed SOW) is provided.
```
Also propose DPA response: provide our subprocessors list + offer a 30-day review window for any customer-specific objections.

maria-sales: Thanks — I'll propose that to NovaHealth. One more ask from them: can we whitelist their IPs for signed callbacks and provide SSO redirect URIs?

tara-ops: We can whitelist IPs on Hosted for callback endpoints. SSO redirect URIs are config-level; ok. For the attestation, we can return HSM-signed JWTs from our KMS which prove signature provenance without handing over keys. That keeps us compliant and addresses their ask.

maria-sales: Perfect. I'll push back on key transfer and present: 25% prepay + HSM-attested signatures + subprocessors list + 30-day DPA review.

novahealth-rep: (via DM) Appreciate the quick turnaround — will run the 25% prepay idea by procurement now. If they accept, legal will stop redlines.

devops-bot: Deployment job #47218 started for novahealth/poc-dedicated (eta 3m).

maria-sales: Awesome — keeping this thread for audit. If anything changes, ping here. :thumbsup:
